parsed.claim_reason: P(a_{n+1}) must hit all earlier prime sets, but the least qualifying integer typically carries superfluous extra primes. E.g. from a_1=2,a_2=3 greedy gives 6,12,18,24,30; P(30)={2,3,5} strictly contains the hitting set {2,3}, so it is not inclusion-minimal. Such superfluous factors are unavoidable in general.
